title: Nuevas prioridades
goal: Read how US policy toward Latin America shifted from a single anti-communist axis to new axes, including free trade through the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative and the fight against drug trafficking in the Andes.

items: State the single axis US policy had revolved around for decades.
Name two of the new axes: free trade and counter-narcotics.
Describe the idea behind the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative.
Explain how policy toward the Andean countries came to revolve around drug trafficking.
Use girar en torno a to name a policy's central axis.
